$comment: The DELIVERY alone -- what Resend POSTs, from https://resend.com/docs/webhooks/emails/received on 2026-09-15 -- not the composite the trigger publishes. The then-read adds `email` and `verdicts` on top of this in every runtime, fake mode included: email_get is faked with this event's email_id, so `email.id` equals `data.email_id` exactly as it would after a real read. The email_id is a VALUE so the two draws cannot disagree.
